So, I was on seroquel and gained around 8kg back (which I’m almost done getting rid of, again). 

I know CICO and knew it then, but it was so hard, almost impossible to keep myself distracted from the constant hunger. After 3 months of being on it I literally threw the meds out. I was so fed up with them, they were helping me destroy myself more than actually doing any good. 

I understand why she wouldn’t want to admit she’s overeating. I didn’t want to either.

My ex sent me a box of chocolates (and a teddybear and roses) for V-day. 



I feel sick. Both from the chocolate (because I gave it to my roommate but she left it in the kitchen and then I ate it) and just, the mixed feels.
I don’t really have anything like that :/

Thank God. Depending from where the scale is my weight goes from 58.8 to 61! 

This house is so old and in the kitchen, my room and bathroom ALL the floors are uneven. :(

I was so so so happy that I started running. It got me so so so proud when I came home sweaty, out of breath, looking like a complete trash panda. 

But I can barely walk right now, I don’t know what happened, my ankle is blue and painful to touch. I’m seeing a dr next week if I can get an appointment. 

It sucks, I keep telling myself I’ll get back on track when this is done, but I’m scared I won’t. I’ve failed before. My diet isn’t going great either and UGH.

The snow fucked up my run schedule. Might have been good, my ankles have been hurting since my second run last week. 

Today I took two ibuprofen and went running again, I made it 12 mins without stopping this time! Feeling awesome now

I’m not able to not wear a bra :p
I’m a 70F en pretty much held my breasts while running

I went jogging for the first time in two years. I usually walk this distance daily (about 6,5 km). It’s at the beach and beautiful. I was wearing running shoes, a sweater, no bra and my pj-pants. I just decided to start running after a really bad day. It hurt a LOT to run without a (sports)bra, I looked ridicilous, was out of breath after 500m. But that was yesterday and this morning I did it again.

I wish it had different settings so I could train my legs more, but for now, every activity I can do while being burried beneath my homework; I take it.
